title: Measure stock rider sag

applicability.included: Exact standard US2020 YZ250FX original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, replacement springs/components or aftermarket damping conversions

entry_state: Assembled bike, serviceable stock suspension, exact original adjusters identified.
exit_state: Actual rider sag recorded; preload adjustment and rear-frame access remain separate work.
preflight: Stop for leaks, damage, binding or an unidentified adjuster.
Keep the linked diagrams visible to identify distinct controls.
critical_stop_conditions: Adjuster at stop before target, inability to identify stock control, or unresolved setup measurement

required_tools.name: Secure maintenance stand, helper and length measuring equipment

source.document_revision: BAJ-28199-10; ©2020 by Yamaha Motor Corporation, U.S.A.
source.review_note: Exact US source author and independent mechanical review accepted this bounded setup companion. Actual work and measurements remain rider records.

steps.title: Confirm stock spring and serviceability
steps.instruction: Confirm smooth leak-free stock rear suspension before measuring. No spring rings or bodywork are removed in this measurement operation.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Measure the unloaded reference
steps.instruction: Support under the engine with rear wheel fully off the ground. Measure distance a between rear axle center and the rear-fender holding bolt shown PDF 364. Record both reference points and the measurement; use them unchanged throughout.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Measure with the rider
steps.instruction: Remove the stand and support the bike upright with a helper. With the rider astride the seat, measure distance b between the same axle center/fender holding bolt. Record rider/equipment for repeatability. Calculate a minus b; Yamaha target is 90–100 mm.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Record the accepted setup
steps.instruction: Record unloaded a, rider-loaded b and calculated sag. The target is 90–100 mm. Outside that range, arrange separate preload adjustment with the source-required rear-frame removal/refit and locknut service. Keep the bike assembled and the rings intact here. Recheck sag after break-in or spring settling.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

completeness: Measure rider sag and actual spring preload; adjust the original spring within the OEM limits and record the accepted setup. A valid measured setup can be retained without adjustment.

authoring_template.scope: Structure only; values, controls, sequence and sag datum reviewed in this exact manual.
